Cost allocation: the PUC adds new costs to DA accounts and/or disproportionately shifts existing costs to DA accounts. Costs with greatest risk of being shifted to DA customers include: IOU undercollection, bonds to repay the state general fund, and DWR contracts. messages.subject: Notice of Shipper Status Suspension — Enron Interruptible Transportation Agreement
messages.body:
Dear Tana,

Please be advised that pursuant to Section 7(c) of the Interruptible Transportation Service Agreement between Rocky Mountain Pipeline and Enron (the "Agreement"), we have completed our quarterly creditworthiness review of Enron.

Based on current publicly available ratings data, Enron's senior unsecured credit rating no longer meets the minimum investment-grade threshold specified in the Agreement's creditworthiness clause. Accordingly, and consistent with the automatic suspension provision of Section 7(c), Enron's shipper status under the Agreement is suspended effective immediately as of the date of this notice.

Please find attached our formal written notice for your records: RM Pipeline Creditworthiness Review Mar2001.pdf.

We ask that you confirm receipt of this notice at your earliest convenience. Should Enron wish to cure this deficiency by posting an acceptable form of credit support, please contact our credit desk directly to discuss available remedies under the Agreement.

Regards,
Credit Review Desk
Rocky Mountain Pipeline
